title: Ootle Street: Nights Edition
creator: Snateri
summary: November 23, 2026: The creator describes browser racing with islands, bridges, ghost-mode timing and collisions. The browser demo runs client-side; its displayed escrow balances are not blockchain payment evidence. The README identifies companion Esmeralda template f96acf40ccf1dd2084b89c964a7ed1d2130b3fbb5a5aba2fb264dbb583da4a71 and reports nine engine tests. These results were not rerun; current deployment confirmation remains pending. Review covered the complete submission, README and MIT license metadata. Public app text extraction failed; app availability and operation were not established today. The recording shows the README with page scripts and downloads disabled. No wallet, funds or third-party code was operated.
cardSummary: Explore a Miami street-racing prototype with local escrow simulation and a separately described Esmeralda contract.
